capabilities.justification: The fuzz engine (VER06n) runs every target execution in its own monitored, heap-limited BEAM process and kills it on a wall-clock timeout; one process per execution, none outlive their execution.
The execution process reports its outcome to the engine in one message, and the engine waits with a bounded receive for the process's exit notification.
The executor computes a wall-clock deadline with System.monotonic_time/1 for each target execution; no calendar time is read.

justification: No filesystem, network, clock or environment access. The fuzz engine spawns one monitored process per target execution (and the PBT budget helpers spawn on request); tests read the committed pbt-v1 and fuzz-v1 fixtures and Go's fuzz reference-vector table.
